M01.title: Where space begins
M01.fact: The World Air Sports Federation uses the 100 km Kármán line as its boundary of space. First Flight aims for that same height.

M02.title: Falling around Earth
M02.fact: An orbit is a continuous fall. With enough sideways speed, a spacecraft keeps missing the ground as Earth curves away beneath it.

M03.title: The Moon as a way home
M03.fact: After an explosion forced Apollo 13 to abandon its landing, the crew used the lunar module's engine to set a course around the Moon and back toward Earth.

M04.title: Finding a clear landing spot
M04.fact: As Apollo 11 approached the Moon, Neil Armstrong took manual control of Eagle to fly past a boulder field and find a clearer place to land.
